findings.evidence: Lines 128, 134, 186, 197: same file, `smul_add_smul` vs `smul_add_add_smul_sub` for the two distinct expressions.
findings.fix: Rename to `apply_sub_smul_add_add_smul_sub`, matching `isCovariant_smul_add_add_smul_sub` and `IsCovariant.exists_eq_smul_add_add_smul_sub`. (`apply_sub_smul_add_eq_zero`, line 215, is already consistent: its argument really is `A • (p + p')`.)
findings.issue: `apply_sub_smul_add_smul` is about `g (p' - p) (A • (p + p') + B • (p' - p))`, but this file already uses `smul_add_smul` for `a • p + b • p'` (`isCovariant_smul_add_smul`, line 128) and `smul_add_add_smul_sub` for the sum/difference combination (`isCovariant_smul_add_add_smul_sub`, line 134). The name therefore reads as the contraction of the wrong structure.

findings.evidence: Lines 252 and 280; the module docstring (line 52) cites `gWit_sub_pWit` as the non-conservation fact, which the name alone does not convey.
findings.fix: Rename to something that states the conclusion, e.g. `gWit_sub_pWit_self_eq_neg_twelve` (or `gWit_sub_pWit_self`).
findings.issue: `gWit_sub_pWit : gWit (pWit' - pWit) (pWit' - pWit) = -12` — the name mentions neither that the pairing is with itself, nor `pWit'`, nor the value, and is nearly indistinguishable from the neighbouring `gWit_sub_pWit_spectator_eq_zero` (line 280), which is a different pairing.

findings.evidence: Lines 320, 327, 336 of the new file; `grep -n pairing EpsilonEridani/QFT/Scattering/DIS/Tensors/Basic.lean` → lines 538, 869.
findings.fix: Reserve `apply_*` for `F` and name the conservation lemma after the contraction, e.g. `HasFormFactor.pairing_sub_eq_zero`, following the `pairing` vocabulary already used upstream (`pairing_invariant_of_fixed`, `pTransverse_pairing` in DIS/Tensors/Basic.lean lines 538, 869).
findings.issue: Inside `namespace HasFormFactor`, `apply` denotes two different functions: `apply_sub_eq_zero` (line 320) is about `g (p' - p) (J p p') = 0`, while `apply_zero_eq` (line 336) and `apply_eq_of_hasFormFactor` (line 327) are about `F` applied. A consumer reading `hF.apply_zero_eq` and `hF.apply_sub_eq_zero` cannot tell which object is being applied.
`tendsto_mul_singlePole_atBot` names only the source filter; the limit `𝓝 (-(e * Λsq))` — the whole content of the statement — is absent, unlike Mathlib's `tendsto_<fn>_<source>_<target>` pattern.

findings.evidence: Line 44 vs the statements at lines 173–175 and 186–188.
findings.issue: Module docstring: "Covariance alone leaves two structures, the sum `P = p + p'` and the difference `q = p' - p` (`FormFactor.IsCovariant.exists_eq_smul_add_smul`)" cites the wrong declaration — `exists_eq_smul_add_smul` (line 173) concludes `J = a • p + b • p'`; the sum/difference statement is `exists_eq_smul_add_add_smul_sub` (line 186).

findings.evidence: Line 285 of the new file; DIS/Tensors/Basic.lean lines 1069, 1110 for the witness-suffix convention.
findings.issue: `not_isCovariant_spectator` is a statement about the witness transition (`gWit pWit pWit'`), but carries no witness marker, unlike every other lemma in the section (`isCovariant_pWit'_sub_pWit`, `gWit_sub_pWit_spectator_eq_zero`, `elasticSpectatorAssumptions_pWit`) and unlike the upstream convention `not_isLorentzCovariant_wWit`, `spectatorAssumptions_kWit`.

summary: Structure names and the witness-definition style follow the existing DIS Tensors precedents, and no notation is introduced, but several theorem names misdescribe their statements: `apply_sub_smul_add_smul` reuses a fragment the file already assigns to a different expression, `gWit_sub_pWit` names neither its argument pair nor its value, `apply` means two different functions inside `HasFormFactor`, and one module-docstring pointer names the wrong declaration.
